figure6.src: Figure 6 (figures_tariq/story_graph.tex); the released annotation for work S60 has the same telling, arrows and questions

edges.note: Each arrow is [from, to] by chronological rank. A REVEALS arrow adds the number of its reader question: the consequence (to) raises it and the explanation (from) resolves it.

expected.src: Figure 6; §3: an annotated work with four reveals and four reader questions

figure6.caption: Story graph of an annotated work. Node numbers give chronological ranks; smaller numbers give telling positions. Arrows encode causes, foreshadowing, and reveals. A REVEALS arrow points from a later-told explanation to the earlier-told event it explains; q_i labels the associated reader question.
